stories.title: Data centers are changing America's landscape, report says
stories.simple_summary: Large computer buildings that power AI and the internet are being built in many places across America and changing the areas around them.
stories.why_it_matters: This affects local communities where these buildings are built — they can bring jobs but also use lots of electricity and water, so it's worth paying attention if one is planned near you.

stories.title: Trump tries to rename AI 'super intelligence' as polls show him sinking on key issue
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is now offering tools like Word and Excel that compete with Microsoft Office — software for writing documents and making spreadsheets.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft Office for your business, you'll soon have another option, though it's too new to know yet if it's better or worse.

stories.title: OpenAI DevDay recap: AI lab rolls out Dots agents, Altman and Friar comment on IPO
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (the company behind ChatGPT) showed off new features at an event and talked about possibly becoming a public company that anyone can invest in.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who work in tech — not something an ordinary person needs to act on right now.

stories.title: Pope Leo Contradicts Trump, Says Artificial Intelligence Safety Concerns Are Not 'Fake News'
stories.simple_summary: A religious leader disagreed with a politician about whether AI safety concerns are real or not, saying the concerns are valid.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a public debate about whether we should worry about AI risks — honest people disagree, but it doesn't change what you should do today.

stories.title: OpenAI repotedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is trying to raise a huge amount of money ($30 billion) from investors before the company goes public in 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Cruz blocks Senate Democrats’ bid to pass AI safety bill
stories.simple_summary: A senator blocked a bill that would have made rules about keeping AI safe.
stories.why_it_matters: This means America probably won't get new AI safety rules soon — a policy decision that affects the whole country, but not something a small business owner needs to handle immediately.

stories.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is not publicly supporting a safety project from another company, but is working with them behind the scenes.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech engineers and investors — it's a business relationship between big companies.

stories.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is now offering tools like Word and Excel that compete with Microsoft Office — software for writing documents and making spreadsheets.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft Office for your business, you'll soon have another option, though it's too new to know yet if it's better or worse.

stories.title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
stories.simple_summary: A startup that makes AI apps is changing its focus to be more like a personal AI assistant you chat with that also performs tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a startup change — mostly relevant to investors and tech workers, not affecting ordinary small businesses right now.

stories.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI created something called 'Dots' — little AI helpers that work in the background on your computer or phone to do ongoing tasks you ask them to do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is new and experimental — it's too early to know if it will be useful for real small business work.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new version of its AI software (called GPT-6.1 Sol) that does complex work like writing computer code and organizing documents better than before, and it's cheaper to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use OpenAI's services for professional tasks, this update gives you a faster and cheaper option — worth knowing about if you're already using their tools.

stories.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT is getting new add-on features that make it work more like a full software program with buttons, panels, and the ability to automate repetitive tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT regularly, these features will make it more useful for doing real business work like organizing files and repeating tasks automatically.
